notes: CHECKPOINT 1 slice: the first 8 ids only, on the coordinator's instruction.

Many recipe keys this group unblocks sit in whitelist/recipes.json -> exclude (they were excluded while their inputs were unobtainable). CddaLoader.js:101 applies `include` after the exclude filter, so they are re-enabled through recipesInclude instead of by editing the exclude list by hand.

The brief names the raw grain plants `barley`/`oat`/`canola`/`buckwheat`; those CDDA ids are the already-whitelisted threshed grains (`barley`, `buckwheat`) or do not exist (`oat`, `canola`). The raw plants are `barley_stalks`, `oat_stalks`, `canola_stalks`, `buckwheat_stalks` and those are what this group will stage on resume.
batch 2 added 10 raw foods (18 staged in this group)

BATCHES.md asks for "oat" and "canola": neither id exists in CDDA, and the raw plants behind those names (oat_stalks, canola_stalks) were whitelisted meanwhile by the farming_18_09 group. Substituted with two A-grade rows from the same survey tables: pumpkin (the INEDIBLE whole crop, which is what makes pumpkin_cut obtainable) and cucumber_cut (whose uncraft source cucumber is already enabled)
pumpkin carries the INEDIBLE comestible_type: INVALID override, the same pattern as raw_beans/soybean/wheat_stalks above; none of the other nine is INEDIBLE

recipe:paste_nut was in whitelist/recipes.json exclude (its nut inputs were unobtainable); recipesInclude re-enables the autolearn rock_quern variant only - the three mill_* variants stay excluded because the Prologue has no mill
pumpkin_cut needs an explicit comestible_type: FOOD override: it is copy-from pumpkin, so it inherited the INVALID patch that blocks eating the whole crop

cinnamon and curry_powder carry CDDA's INEDIBLE flag, which the game does not enforce, so both get the comestible_type INVALID patch (coordinator double check, batch 2): seasonings are recipe components, not snacks.
batch 3 added 18 raw foods and dishes plus the cucumber loot fix (37 staged in this group)

INEDIBLE audit of every id staged in this batch (CDDA flags resolved through copy-from): only seed_mustard (from the seed abstract) and mustard_powder (from the spice abstract) carry INEDIBLE, and both got comestible_type INVALID. tomato, tomato_cut, zucchini, eggplant, orange, pomegranate, mango, pine_nuts, acorns_cooked, honey_glassed and the five dishes are all edible in CDDA

three ids beyond the batch list (ghee, curry_veggy, sushi_rice) give the two cookbooks something to unlock: without them cookbook_indian and cookbook_sushi teach nothing the Prologue can craft, they only train cooking. Each is a survey row (ghee B, curry_veggy A, sushi_rice B) and each is learnable only from its book

recipesInclude grew by egg_salad, grenadine_syrup, honey_bottled:from_honey_glassed, sugar:from_candy and sauce_pesto: all five are whitelisted results whose keys sat in whitelist/recipes.json exclude while their inputs were unobtainable
